# Ming Yi Lim

> Singapore-based growth and lifecycle marketer with 12+ years across B2B, DTC and B2B2C in APAC. Builds AI-native marketing systems: SEO/GEO, Klaviyo lifecycle automation, Shopify Admin API workflows and documented rulesets run with Claude Code and MCP. Fluent in English, Mandarin and Malay.

## Selected work

- Hyve Promo (2025–2026): Built the marketing stack across 7 APAC markets. Took a new domain from zero to 30,000+ search impressions in six months and earned a cited-source position in Perplexity for category queries. Built six Klaviyo lifecycle flows and migrated the HubSpot database into Klaviyo, suppressing about 40% of the list as inactive before the first send; bounce rate stayed under 0.8%.
- Best World International (2021–2025): Localised marketing and go-to-market execution across 13+ international regions, including Australia and the USA. Marketed paid events and conventions, including the 2023 North American Convention in Las Vegas (about 2,000 participants against a 1,000–1,500 target).
- Fill Apac (2019–2021): Grew e-commerce revenue 200% year on year and improved ROAS 50%. Launched four marketplace stores (Shopee, Lazada, Qoo10, Amazon).
- Earlier: Marketing Lead at Jasper Healthcare (2017–2019, tripled lead generation in 12 months); Sales & Marketing Executive at Nova Mulia Development (2014–2017); co-founder of Awesome International (2012–2016), winner of the EO Business Plan Competition (Malaysia) and global finalist at the New York Stock Exchange.

## Education

- Mini MBA in Marketing (Certificate), Marketing Week, 2025
